dropped.item: The explicit call to action and what the open day offers: 'Please come along, meet the team and hear more about the work you help us do'
Closing thanks addressed to all kinds of supporters: 'Whether you've donated, raised funds or cheered us on, thank you for being part of it'
The link between donors' generosity and the team's ability to respond: 'your generosity helps us be there when we're needed'
The Land Rover described as 'a welcome addition to the team and a reminder of what your support makes possible'
Land Rover framed as 'due to arrive' (scheduled), now 'looking forward to taking delivery'. The scheduling sense is softened.

changed.item: Timing of the season: the original says autumn has arrived ('As autumn settles over the hills'), while the edit says it is still ahead ('focusing on the coming autumn')
Scope of the invitation: the original invites everyone, while the edit makes it conditional with 'If you are in the area'

added.item: 'we have been pretty busy this year' as a characterization of the workload
Land Rover described as 'brand new' rather than simply 'new'
Conditional 'If you are in the area' on the open day invitation
